single.rationale: BBOT is a clinical-stage oncology company with potentially differentiated KRAS inhibitors showing early promise, but faces substantial execution risk. While the company dramatically improved its balance sheet (cash jumped from $31M to $374M and equity turned positive), operating losses are accelerating sharply (from $81M to $146M), and the 241,000% share dilution suggests massive equity financing. Clinical data readouts in H2 2026 could be catalysts, but typical early-stage biotech risks dominate.

team.thesis: BBOT is a clinical-stage oncology company with two dual-state KRAS inhibitors targeting the most frequently mutated oncogene family in cancer. A 2025 recapitalization increased cash from $30.9M to $373.7M and transformed equity from negative $178.6M to positive $411.1M, providing approximately 3 years of runway at the current $113.9M annual operating cash burn, but at the cost of extreme dilution
